bundle.preview: Recognized format. Access control, DNS and connection lifecycle remain managed by SXB.
bundle.sshKey: Base64 SSH private key (alternative to a password)
bundle.upMbps: Upload rate in Mbit/s (required for Hysteria1)

lock.help: Use a password separate from VPN credentials: at least 6 characters and at most 72 UTF-8 bytes (a numeric code like "123338" works). Locking is immediate, with no role exemptions. Unlocking lasts 10 minutes; assignment and mobile provisioning do not require it.
lock.invalid: Use at least 6 characters, at most 72 UTF-8 bytes and two matching passwords.
lock.mustDiffer: The lock password must differ from the VPN password.

errors.PROFILE_NOT_LOCKED: This configuration does not have a protection password yet.
errors.PROFILE_LOCK_FIELDS_FORBIDDEN: Use the change password action to update the configuration lock.
errors.PROFILE_UNLOCK_UNAVAILABLE: Unlocking is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
errors.PROFILE_LOCK_UNAVAILABLE: The protection password could not be updated. Please try again.
errors.PROFILE_ENGINE_NOT_FOUND: The engine account linked to this configuration was not found.
errors.PROFILE_ENGINE_LINK_INVALID: The link between the configuration and its engine is invalid.
errors.PROFILE_LOCKED: The configuration is locked or your proof expired. Unlock it again.
errors.PROFILE_LOCK_PASSWORD_INVALID: The password does not meet the required limits.
errors.PROFILE_UNLOCK_RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait before trying again.
errors.PROFILE_ENGINE_LINK_AMBIGUOUS: Multiple engine accounts match this profile. Resolve the link before adding a lock.
errors.PROFILE_ENGINE_LINKED: This profile is linked to an engine account and cannot be deleted separately.

ui.tlsTunnelHint: : SSH traffic travels inside a TLS session without injecting HTTP headers. This is the "SSL" mode in tunneling clients. Set the

ui.reimportSecretsMissing: The current configuration was preloaded, but {{fields}} cannot be read back: it is encrypted and the server never returns it. Replace the placeholder before saving.

ssh.detected: Ambiguous SSH format: use the form or a recognized Settings export.
ssh.detectedHint: Open manual entry and fill in the host, port, user, password and, if needed, the payload. You then validate exactly what the app will use.
ssh.importRefused: This SSH format is not recognized. Use “SSH — Manual entry” or a complete Protocols Settings export.
ssh.modeHint: Direct: open SSH port (22). TLS: SSL tunnel (443). Payload: HTTP/WebSocket header before SSH. Proxy: through an HTTP CONNECT proxy. SlowDNS: DNS tunnel (DNSTT).
ssh.incomplete: Fill in the SSH host, port, user and a password or private key.
ssh.sniHint: Name presented during TLS; empty = server name.
ssh.hostHint: Domain name, IPv4 or IPv6. The domain is preserved; there is no need to replace it with an IP.
ssh.userAgentHint: Replaces [ua] without changing other headers. Leave blank for the shared probe/app default, or copy the provider’s value when required.
